title: Site Architecture & Technical SEO
description: Whether search engines can crawl, understand, and index the site: robots, sitemap, URL structure, internal linking, redirects, and indexation.

items.check: robots.txt is valid and does not block important pages.
items.pass_criteria: Present, parseable, no disallow on key templates.

items.check: XML sitemap exists, is current, and is submitted.
items.pass_criteria: Reachable, valid, lists canonical URLs, referenced in robots.txt.

items.check: URLs are clean, readable, and consistent.
items.pass_criteria: Lowercase, hyphenated, no needless params, stable pattern.

items.check: No orphan pages; important pages are shallow.
items.pass_criteria: Key pages reachable within 3 clicks; no orphans.
Single-hop 301s; no chains/loops; no broken links.
One canonical host/protocol; no conflicting signals.

items.check: Important pages are indexed; nothing is accidentally noindexed.
items.pass_criteria: Key pages indexed; no unintended noindex/blocked.
